citations.claim: first violation: body 2 overlaps wall 2 by 0.165 at step 25
body 2 approaches wall at high speed just before penetration
body 2 still outside wall one step before, closing rapidly

counterfactual.change: reduced dt from 0.02732 to 0.002 with identical bodies, walls, gravity, steps; finer temporal resolution resolves the grazing corner contact so no penetration occurs

explanation: Body 2 is accelerated via collisions to ~29.7 m/s toward the corner of wall 2 (box x=14.89,y=1.68,w=2.85,h=2.08). Per-step displacement ~0.8m is comparable to radius 1.09. At step 24 it is 0.055 outside the wall; at step 25 it is 0.165 inside, exceeding the 0.15 tolerance. The discrete impulse plus positional correction with dt=0.0273 and 28 substeps fails to resolve the fast grazing corner contact, letting the circle clip into the box side/corner without an adequate bounce.
vision_note: The red circle sits just on top of the small dark block in step 24 and then moves rightward off the edge. In step 25 its lower-left side overlaps the block's top-right corner, clipping into the wall instead of bouncing off.
